title: grid account status output
description: JSON output of grid account status --json and of grid account list --json, which runs the same writer (internal/cli/account.go:47 and :87) and differs only in that list registers nothing. Every account carries all ten keys; the app reads id, kind, name, dir, default and signedIn (worker account.go:71-80).

dir.description: The account's config folder as an absolute path.

default.description: True when this account's email is the one signed in on ~/.claude (or ~/.codex).

signedIn.description: null when the scan could not tell, for example when the provider's program is not installed.

plan.description: The login's plan, or the empty string when unknown.

added.description: auto when Grid saw the email, person when the person added it.
